76.1424 πάλιν ἀνθυποστρόφως εὑρήσει κατὰ σύλληψιν τοῦ αὐτοῦ ρ, σημαῖνον
ὕψιστος· ἑρμηνεύεται γὰρ δηλονότι τὸ μὰρ, ὕψιστος· ὅπερ τοῦ παναγίου Πνεύματος
αἰνίττεται τὴν ὑπόστασιν· Θεὸν αὐτὸν πεφυκέναι καὶ εἶναι περιφραστικῶς ἡμᾶς
διδασκούσης τῆς λέξεως· οὐδὲν γὰρ ἕτερον ὁ ὕψιστος πέφυκεν, ἀλλ' ἢ πάντως κατὰ
φύσιν Θεός. Ταύτης οὖν ὑπὸ Θεοῦ τῷ πατριάρχῃ δοθείσης ἀντωνομασίας, εὕρηται
pass_a_gloss: End of the third demonstration: reading backwards while sweeping in that rho gives a word for the Most High, because mar plainly means most high. That title points in riddle form to the Holy Spirit’s own person: the roundabout phrasing instructs us that the Spirit exists as God in his very being, for none but God by nature can bear the name Most High. Transitional sentence begun: the God-given new name proves something to have been discovered.
pass_b_english: he will again discover, in reverse order and gathering in the same rho, a grouping that signifies Most High — for ‘mar’ is plainly translated most high — a title that hints at the person of the all-holy Spirit, since the term teaches us indirectly that he is God by nature and truly exists. For the Most High is by nature nothing else but altogether God by nature.
Since this renaming, then, was given to the patriarch by God, there has been found

choices.choice: Follows Cyril’s own gloss Most High rather than Syriac lord.
Hendiadys kept: being God by nature and truly existing as such.
